# Cancellation policy

## Standard plan

Customers on the Standard plan may cancel within **14 days** of purchase for a full refund,
provided no more than two support tickets have been opened.

After day 14, cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period.
No prorated refund is issued for the remaining days of that period.

## Enterprise plan

Enterprise contracts require written notice **30 days** before the renewal date.
Early termination fees are listed in Schedule B of the master services agreement.

## Cooling-off

A cooling-off period of **72 hours** applies to all self-serve purchases.
During cooling-off, the customer may cancel with a single click in the billing portal.
